epistemic_principle: The budget identity (18.0 ms allocated + 15.33 ms reserve = 33.33 ms composite frame target) is an engineering design allocation. It is NOT empirical evidence that physical hardware naturally produces <= 33.33 ms skew. Physical commissioning MUST directly measure real-world temporal offsets using calibrated bench instruments.

physical_measurement_protocols.channel: Camera A, B, C, D Strobe Sync
physical_measurement_protocols.acceptance_rule: measured_value_p99 <= 2.0 ms (nominal PASS); 2.0 ms < measured_value_p99 <= 5.0 ms (conditional PASS); > 5.0 ms (GATE C1 FAIL)
physical_measurement_protocols.measurement_method: Dual-channel high-speed digital storage oscilloscope monitoring PTP 1PPS pulse vs camera opto-isolated flash strobe output pin.

physical_measurement_protocols.acceptance_rule: measured_value_p99 <= 5.0 ms (nominal PASS); 5.0 ms < measured_value_p99 <= 10.0 ms (conditional PASS); > 10.0 ms (GATE C1/C3 FAIL)
physical_measurement_protocols.measurement_method: CANoe hardware logger synchronized to PTP grandmaster comparing CAN message frame EOF arrival vs gateway SOF UDP packet emit time.

instrument.model: Vector VN1640A Network Interface with PTP Slave Sync

physical_measurement_protocols.acceptance_rule: measured_value_p99 <= 5.0 ms (nominal PASS); > 5.0 ms (GATE C1/C4 FAIL)
physical_measurement_protocols.measurement_method: PTP Ethernet packet timestamp inspection at switch ingress port mirroring using Wireshark hardware timestamping capture card.

instrument.model: Fiberblaze Silicom FB2CGg3 Capture NIC (PTP synchronized)

physical_measurement_protocols.acceptance_rule: max_observed_skew <= 18.0 ms (OPTIMAL); 18.0 ms < max_observed_skew <= 33.33 ms (ACCEPTABLE_RESERVE_CONSUMED); > 33.33 ms (GATE C1 REJECTED)
physical_measurement_protocols.measurement_method: Physical multi-modal flash/motion event: LED strobe fires concurrently with solenoid impactor tapped onto vehicle accelerometer, observed optically by cameras and captured by CAN IMU.
